title: EEF-video VLM review answer (eef-review/1.0)
description: What the model returns for one review window (design doc 12 §10.2). Classes only: no pixel, millimetre or angle values. evidence_frame_ids must be frame ids shown in the request (checked by the runner, not by this Schema).

review_status.description: Overall: does the declared projection (red) sit on the physical point it defines, over this window?

target_visible.description: The gripper and the defined point are visible in most frames of the window

tracking_target_correct.description: The independent observation (green) follows the defined point, not another object

position_support.description: support: the declared point is on the defined physical point; refute: it is visibly off

orientation_support.description: support: the declared axis points the way the gripper does; refute: it visibly does not

background_motion_support.description: support: the scene behind the gripper stays still (camera not shaking)

explanation.description: Short reason in words; measured values (px, mm, cm, degrees) are refused by the runner
